facts.label: Gerúndio e infinitivo
facts.sub: Alguns verbos pedem to + verbo (want to learn, hope to build) e outros pedem -ing (enjoy solving, avoid giving up). Aprenda cada um em bloco.

facts.label: querer + verbo
facts.sub: Use want to, hope to, decide to, need to com verbo base: I want to learn, I hope to build, I decided to take. Muito comum para planos e metas.

facts.label: gostar de + -ing
facts.sub: Use enjoy, avoid, suggest, keep, mind com -ing: I enjoy solving, avoid giving up, suggest starting. Não use to depois desses verbos.

pages.title: A cafe in Toronto · 1/3
paragraphs: It is a cold evening in Toronto. Carla and Leo meet after work. Leo works with computers every day. Carla wants to try something new. She is excited but a little afraid. Leo knows how it feels to begin.

“Leo, I want to learn coding. Do you enjoy writing programs?” says Carla. “I do! I started learning two years ago, and I enjoy solving problems.” says Leo. “I’m afraid I’m not good at math. Is that a problem?” says Carla.
